acceptance: A commit gate run with a test that is red on the base prints base-red lines that name the commit gate.
The build floor's base-red lines are unchanged.
A test pins both texts through the stage value.
fix: Pass the judge's stage to the base-red attribution, so each line names the stage that runs it. Keep the build floor text unchanged.

summary: The commit gate now runs the repo-contract pack through core.RepoContractJudge with a stage value. The refusal line says [commit-gate], but the base-red attribution lines in go/internal/core/base_red_floor.go still print [build-floor] when base-red attribution fires during a commit gate run.
title: The base-red attribution lines name the commit gate when the commit gate runs the repo-contract pack
